description: The most common and versatile greeting in Spanish. It is friendly and neutral, and can be used in both casual and formal situations when meeting or addressing someone.
A polite Spanish greeting meaning “good morning.” It is commonly used during the morning and is appropriate in both casual and formal situations.
A polite Spanish greeting meaning “good afternoon” or “good evening.” It is generally used from the afternoon into the early evening and works in both casual and formal situations.
A Spanish greeting meaning “good evening” or “good night.” It is used in the evening and at night, both when meeting someone and when saying goodbye.
A friendly and informal Spanish greeting that literally asks “how are things?” It is commonly used simply as a greeting and usually does not require a detailed answer.
